$comment: Mini App design styles: named directions an agent applies on request ('make it look like a fintech app', 'calmer', 'denser'). A style changes shape, density, type emphasis, glass and which components a screen reaches for; colours always come from the user's Telegram theme (G1), and brand colour is allowed only on one moment per screen. Compiled by scripts/miniapp_style.py into overrides of the kit tokens in examples/mini-apps/_kit/tma.css. Rules: references/mini-apps/design-system.md section 9.

--tma-r-group.what: radius of inset groups and cards

--tma-r-inner.what: radius of inputs, snackbars, nested surfaces (outer minus padding)

--tma-avatar.what: avatar and icon tile size in rows

--tma-gap-surface.what: space between two stacked surfaces (cards, groups): never touching

--tma-fs-body.what: body size in rem of a 17 px root

native.title: Telegram native
native.intent: Looks like a part of Telegram: settings-style inset groups, system type, hairlines, native buttons.
use_for: any app with no brand brief
do: one accent: the theme button colour

fintech.title: Dark fintech
fintech.intent: Numbers lead: one large figure per screen with its change, quick-action tiles, quiet asset lists, one chart, glass tab bar. Designed dark-first, checked light.

components.hero: figure + delta pill with sign and period
components.lists: asset rows: avatar, title, 'ticker · price', value right
components.chart: one line, colour by direction, muted grid, segmented period
components.glass: tab bar and the side circle

do: fraction and currency in hint colour at about 60 % size
green/red only with a sign or arrow
one promo moment, dismissible and remembered

soft.title: Soft commerce
soft.intent: Friendly and roomy: larger radii, generous rows, image-led cards, tonal buttons in content. For browsing and buying.

components.cards: product cards with one image, title, price

do: real product photos with alt text
empty states that lead back to the catalogue
dont: pill shapes on everything including cards

dense.title: Dense tool
dense.intent: Compact and information-rich: 44 px rows, small radii, full-width lists on Android, solid surfaces. For people who use it every day.

profile_schema.radius: sharp | default | round: scales the preset's radii by 0.5 / 1 / 1.25
profile_schema.density: compact | default | roomy: rows and section gaps -8 / 0 / +8 px
profile_schema.glass: true | false: false turns the floating glass into solid surfaces
profile_schema.brand: optional {"light": "#RRGGBB", "dark": "#RRGGBB", "on": "#RRGGBB"}: the colour of one moment per screen (hero header, promo); text on it uses 'on' and is contrast-checked in both schemes
profile_schema.figure: optional CSS size of the hero figure
